{{< include ../_includes/hw-submission-instructions.qmd >}}

Homework is the central place to find every released assignment and the reading solution pages that go with those assignments.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Start Here

- Need the assignment itself? Use the table below to open any released homework page.
- Need worked reading solutions? Jump to [Solution links](#solution-links) for the lecture-by-lecture pages tied to each homework.
- Need to submit? Upload your worked solutions and grade memo in [Canvas](https://sdsu.instructure.com).
:::

## Released Homework

Homework is one of the main ways you build the skills you need for exams: clear reasoning, careful units, and honest self-assessment.
